items.new_text: Given a project's package-source settings, hook and tool configuration, and documentation files, when the scan runs, then it also reports, as a warning that never stops a release, a package source redirected away from its default registry, a hook or setting that sends data to another machine or runs a command by itself, text padded with blanks to hide content, wording that tells the assistant to drop its safety rules, a tool grant that covers everything, and a program disguised as a document.
